Q: How can I guarantee the fingerprint value was not faked in the request from client side? A:

Checking the integrity of client side fingerprint is not possible... The best bet for you is to use PHP to detect the internal systems. I wrote a library to that, but it is not published. If you need it, I can send it to you.

This library detects the MAC address of the device. Since two systems can't have the same MAC address, it's a very good way of getting accurate fingerprint.

Q: SELECT rows WHERE a datetime value is BETWEEN two datetime columns in MySQL A:

This is just the overlapping range problem. To find records which overlap with your own date range, try this query:

SELECT *
FROM transactionmaster
WHERE '2018-09-17 11:00:00' < checkout AND '2018-09-18 11:00:00' > checkin;
